Master Services Agreement

between Meridian Analytics Ltd and the Customer

1. Term and Renewal

This Agreement commences on the Effective Date and continues for an initial term of twelve months. The Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve-month periods unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least ninety days before the end of the then-current term.

2. Service Levels

The Provider will use reasonable endeavours to make the Service available at all times. Scheduled maintenance will be announced at least five business days in advance and performed outside normal business hours where practicable.

3. Customer Obligations

  1. Keep account credentials confidential
  2. Use the Service in accordance with the documentation
  3. Notify the Provider promptly of any suspected security incident
